reason: I already send my sale news on WhatsApp for free and I've paid for Facebook boosts this month, so I don't see why I'd pay for SMS on top. I might send the 10 free test messages to my own phone out of curiosity, but that doesn't mean I'd pay.
objection: My customers already read WhatsApp. I'm not sure an SMS from a shop name brings more people through the door than a free WhatsApp message does.
would_change_my_mind: If the free test arrived properly in Sinhala and a shop like mine nearby showed me it brought in real customers during a sale, I'd try the LKR 560 pack for 12.12.
